status: primary-source review; calibration execution recorded separately
prior_scientific_state: Iter155 closed. No new driving, model calibration or maneuver search in this preparatory review.

sources.name: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super
sources.review: Primary release article. Surround-view reasoning/trajectory/meta-action/label outputs; AlpaSim and AlpaGym ecosystem. Company claims, no Sentinel reproduction.
sources.implication: Use open tools as integration candidates; natural-language reasoning is not a causal validation witness.

sources.name: Waymo World Model
sources.review: Primary article. Genie3 adaptation, camera/lidar generation, action/layout/language control and long rollouts. Public presentation, no accessible comparative Sentinel result.
sources.implication: Visual realism alone does not qualify an outcome evaluator.

sources.name: Wayve GAIA-4
sources.review: Primary article. Logged-agent and reactive-agent modes; outcome, closed-loop and component fidelity. Camera/radar generation. Company describes on-rails mode as conservative.
sources.implication: Make scenario behavior assumptions explicit. Our inference: fixed-agent behavior is not universally a worst case for every action or metric; test its direction of bias.

sources.name: Mobileye Meteor/Genario
sources.review: Primary article already cited in Sentinel Oct9 direction. Hypothesis-driven retrieval, failure groups and targeted generation.
sources.implication: Generic automated failure mining is not a new Sentinel contribution.

sources.name: ECO
sources.review: Sections III-V and TableIII reviewed; prior Sentinel Iter154 FOLLOWUP_REVIEW already covers this. Plan/history-only repair with fixed endpoint, soft smoothness/turn/deviation objective and L-BFGS-B. Aggregate improvements can coexist with worse collision components.
sources.implication: Use as a future competent responsive comparator after interface qualification; not evidence for a new Sentinel result.

sources.name: CausalDrive
sources.review: Method and empirical sections reviewed. Initial image, ego trajectory and language-conditioned reactive video; reported 12.4FPS on A100. Polite-prompt yielding and reduced reported ghost collisions are not an independent physical counterfactual oracle.
sources.implication: Generated reactions need external qualification; do not reward an intervention simply because a generator yields more.

sources.name: Simulation fidelity for motion control
sources.review: Methods/results/conclusion reviewed. Model fidelity tested against a recorded racing lap; controller metrics depend on tire parameters, actuator dynamics and operating envelope. Baseline-as-truth is distinguished from real-world validation in scaled laps.
sources.implication: Calibrate the terms that change decisions and state the reference layer explicitly.

sources.name: Waabi SaLF and research index
sources.date: ICRA 2026, exact initial posting date not established
sources.review: Primary research listing and project page reviewed; sparse multi-sensor rendering research sits alongside reactive traffic and scenario generation.
sources.implication: Do not claim frontier rendering novelty from a UI or an ordinary point-query accelerator.

sources.name: RiskMonitor
sources.review: Abstract rechecked; planner/motion-token collision-loss prediction plus braking. Already covered in Oct9 Sentinel direction.
sources.implication: Internal-token monitoring is an existing baseline, not novelty by itself.

sources.name: Tesla AI and Robotics
sources.review: Public engineering overview; latency/correctness/determinism, fleet and hardware-in-loop evaluation. Contains older architecture descriptions and supplies no dated comparative benchmark for Sentinel.
sources.implication: Do not infer current private architecture or comparative superiority from recruitment copy.

recommended_next_slice.name: Prospective full-population background-predicate calibration
recommended_next_slice.reason: Iter153 omitted background; Iter154 failed there; Iter155 establishes finite source mask witnesses. Closing this exact gap precedes another search.
recommended_next_slice.inventory_only: Ten previously exposed scene-0013 traces: Iter151 nominal x2, Iter152 monitor/brake_t0/brake_t2_5 x2, Iter154 selected x2. 300 step bindings and 115 unique after states. These are not new independent scenes or a held-out evaluation.
recommended_next_slice.candidate_method: Start with bounded NumPy vectorization of the full selected point population and explicit arithmetic order. Benchmark against the separate scalar oracle before adding a spatial index. Do not prune evidence to meet a timing target.
recommended_next_slice.qualification: All 115 complete masks/counts vs scalar; two retained CUDA masks remain distinct. Compare 26 direct background bindings and 266 negative composite implications; eight old positive composite collisions have unknown background labels. No new independent scene.
recommended_next_slice.future_comparison: After calibration, freeze action library, responsive baseline, input interface, latency and progress/burden outcomes before new search or native replay.
